misconceptions.description: Assuming the default Ethobot prompt works equally well for every class regardless of language, age, or context
misconceptions.trigger: learner runs the default prompt with English learners or young students and blames the students when responses are thin
misconceptions.feedback: Adapt the prompt to the class. Replace jargon with a concrete scenario and add scaffolds, then check the transcript for richer reasoning.

misconceptions.description: Adapting a prompt by inserting the teacher's own opinion, which steers students toward a predetermined verdict
misconceptions.trigger: learner edits the prompt to tell students what the right answer is
misconceptions.feedback: Adapt the move, not the conclusion. Scaffold how students reason; do not bake the verdict into the prompt.

misconceptions.description: Reporting that a prompt change helped without pointing to evidence of changed reasoning in a re-run transcript
misconceptions.trigger: learner writes 'it worked better' with no comparison transcript
misconceptions.feedback: Show the evidence. Compare a turn from the default run and the adapted run to demonstrate where reasoning improved.
